# Known violations of the "no file over 300 lines" rule in CLAUDE.md.
#
# This is a DEBT LEDGER, not a permission slip. The CI ratchet allows these
# files to stay at or below the recorded size and nothing more:
#   - grow one of these  -> CI fails
#   - add a new one      -> CI fails
#   - shrink one         -> CI tells you to lower the number here
#
# The intended end state is an empty file. Delete a line whenever you split a
# file below 300, and the ratchet tightens permanently.
#
# Format:  <max-lines> <path>

570 HUMMI/Recording/RecordView.swift
458 HUMMI/Enhancement/ResultViewModel.swift
450 HUMMI/Enhancement/StudioScreen.swift
